S32N observation AP was 0.909 on familiar corruption families and 0.813 on held-out families. PCA reached 0.966 on the latter. In the two shifted test trajectories, the respective AP values were 0.892 and 1.000. These small strata do not establish robust transfer.

The gain is also sensitive to context. Its Spearman correlation with initial witness loss was 0.694 on Intel, and its correlation with channel degree was 0.498 on SKAB. Thus a large gain can partly reflect where improvement was possible, rather than fault identity alone.

A saved development pair illustrates the ranking inequality. Its gain difference was -0.0026, while its combined penalty difference at $\kappa=1,\lambda=0.2$ was -0.0043. The score difference became 0.0017, reversing the order. This arithmetic example explains a ranking change without establishing a detection gain. Across the three development sensitivity windows, the median sampling diagnostic fell from 0.0053 at $M=2$ to 0.0020 at $M=16$. More draws reduce this source of variability without creating independent model members.

In the targeted S32N conditioning experiment, primary-target top-one attribution changed from 1.000 without additional corruption to 0.000 when half of the eligible conditioning channels were shifted. Each condition used 12 evenly spaced reference windows. Additional corrupted channels were distractors for this endpoint, not relabeled primary targets. These runs diagnose dependence on conditioning quality rather than estimate a field failure rate.

At that contamination level, screening retained the primary target in 0.167 of windows. PCA top-one attribution was 0.167. Under the separate requested 30\% graph-error condition, witness repair retained 0.917 top-one attribution. Unknown association-copy aliases retained 1.000 in this small sample, which does not extend known-copy invariance to unknown identities.

The one-source condition withheld high-confidence attribution in all 12 windows. Its separately marked diagnostic top-one rate was 0.833. Dropout produced 12 availability alerts while numeric replacement abstained. Training with 10\% contaminated windows gave primary-target top-one attribution 0.917. The original normalizer and decision parameters remained fixed.

The common-mode construction supplies exactly the same observations under a physical-event story and a coordinated-fault story. Together with the changed-response control it produced 2 accepted candidate explanations in S32N. An accepted repair is therefore not a unique physical diagnosis. The saved latent trajectories expose this ambiguity.

Ordinary CUDA reductions were not bitwise repeatable. Saved predictive samples are the authoritative inputs to the arithmetic audit. Replaying portable weights against the original checkpoints with deterministic reductions gave exact predictive-array agreement. Separate deterministic checks also preserved the trained model output after adding known copies. This distinguishes evidence invariance from floating-point execution order.
